(6)=>(1): universally closed + locally of finite type + monomorphism => finite (More on Morphisms) => proper monomorphism => closed immersion (Morphisms).
(7)=>(1): from (7), via the accepted in-source equivalence, f is a monomorphism locally of finite type and universally closed; proceed as in (6)=>(1).
